infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MathHelper uses the camera so you can photograph a math problem. The photo is sent to our server, where it is analyzed by an AI service to produce a solution. It is stored only if you choose to save the result.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MathHelper accesses your photo library so you can choose a picture of a math problem. The selected photo is sent to our server, where it is analyzed by an AI service to produce a solution. It is stored only if you choose to save the result.
